scope: One illustrative local CPU tool-using language-model episode on previously selected acoustic case C; not an independent agent benchmark
motivation: User requested a tangible agent figure and reported the RunPod GPU unavailable
selection: Existing case C selected before this agent demonstration; acoustic outcomes already inspected by researchers
model_inputs: Task, tool schemas, and actual numeric tool returns; no waveform, dataset class, complete-reference gap, model repair, or reference-based quality score
required_audit: all selected tool calls and returned measurements
CPU residency from local serving process
full final model response and any unsupported statement
success_checks: model configures an analyzed setting meeting the target
final summary checked against tool evidence
limitations: Guided task with two display choices, one preselected case, one seed; no label-accuracy evaluation, hardware control, autonomous-policy comparison, or general reasoning claim
repeat_policy: Preserve the first completed episode and all execution failures; do not select a favorable rerun
